brief: Fischer, Constant term formulas for refined enumerations of Gog and Magog trapezoids (JCTA 158, 2018, 560–604) — alternating sign matrices, plane partitions, constant-term methods.
extended:
**Constant term formulas for refined enumerations of Gog and Magog trapezoids** — Ilse Fischer, Universität Wien. Journal of Combinatorial Theory, Series A 158 (2018) 560–604.

Keywords as printed: alternating sign matrix, plane partition, Gog trapezoid, Magog trapezoid, constant term. Refined enumeration results obtained by constant-term methods.

**Why it may bear here.** ASM / plane-partition enumeration is adjacent to the partition-indexed Wedderburn and character machinery this corpus uses, but the connection is thematic rather than established.
